page.overview:
What is Little Norton?

Little Norton is a town in Great Britain. One of the streets in Little Norton is Acanthia Way. 18 Acanthia Way was the home of Doris Purkiss. It was also at this town's Church Hall that the final concert for The Hobgoblins was held in around 1980, on which Stubby Boardman was "struck in the ear by a turnip" and decided to retire from public life.
